note: 3-day reboot collapsed to 1 available day. Sat/Sun reboot days not done. One quality full-body session — not a cram of three days. Last hard data still 15 Aug. Train off the site even if Arnold is offline.

sessions.title: Full-Body Return
sessions.goal: One clean full-body session after the missed reboot block. Hinge, balanced upper, glute priority, simple squat pattern. Quality over volume.
sessions.success: Technique crisp. Back quiet. Glutes actually worked. Leave 2–3 reps in the tank. Walk out feeling complete, not crushed.
sessions.note: Not catch-up. Covers the highest-value pieces from the 3-day plan in one hour. No BSS. Knee stays quiet — goblet default; reverse lunge only if warm-up check is clean. MoveU still L2 W3.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.focus: Full glute squeeze. Ribs down. Prep for hip thrust.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Front shin vertical. Any under-kneecap pinch → stay goblet later, skip reverse lunge.

blocks.title: Skill — Trap Bar Build-up
blocks.note: Groove the pattern before working sets. Still weeks since last hard hinge.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Control the lower. Stop if brace softens.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 55–65 kg (earn 65 only if sets 1–2 are identical and easy)
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Leave 2–3 in the tank. Quality > load.
exercises.note: 15 Aug peaked 70 then settled 60. Do not open at 70.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.focus: Resist rotation. Exhale on press. Ribs stacked over pelvis.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.focus: Full control. Soft landing at bottom. No bounce.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Pause at top. No torso yank.
exercises.note: 15 Aug note said 17.5 next — only if control is clean after the layoff.

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.prescription: Moderate — start light and earn load (e.g. 40–60 kg BB or heavy DBs)
exercises.focus: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Full glute squeeze at top. No lumbar overextend.
exercises.note: Primary glute builder. Weak glutes remain a structural priority.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat or Reverse Lunge
exercises.prescription: Goblet 16–22 kg; or reverse lunge BW–light DBs (6–12 kg) if warm-up check was clean
exercises.focus: Goblet: controlled depth, knees track toes. Lunge: front shin vertical, no forward knee dive.
exercises.note: Default goblet. Name the variation in notes. No BSS.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Even steps. Grip finishes the set, not form collapse.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: Capacity touch only. Skip if energy tanks — MoveU still happens.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Consistent output. No hero intervals. Drop or skip if flat.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 W3
blocks.note: Still L2 W3 after the gap. Consistency > novelty. No weight. Alignment layer after main session.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.
exercises.note: Optional if time is tight — rotations + stretch are the priority.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.

questions: Back under trap bar vs 15 Aug — better, same, or tighter?
Hip thrusts — did you feel glutes, or more hamstring/back?
Goblet or reverse lunge today, and any joint noise worth noting?
Energy after — drained, about right, or still had room?
